design.name: 驼碑力士
design.brief: A hulking camel strongman tank: an anthropomorphic Bactrian camel with a huge barrel chest, long neck and a grumpy heavy-lidded camel face with a split lip, shaggy brown fur on the shoulders and forearms. Two stone tablets (石碑) are strapped upright over its two humps with ropes, the gap between the humps glowing white-gold with carved inscriptions (weak spot). Wears a faded Dunhuang-patterned saddle blanket as a skirt, bronze nose ring and bells, wrapped shins. Big hands with a clearly separate thumb and four thick fingers; big two-toed camel feet with split hooves wrapped in cloth.
design.weapon: a massive carved stone stele used as a tower shield, held in front
design.turnaround_pose: feet a little wider than shoulder width, knees slightly bent, torso upright, BOTH ARMS IN EXACTLY THE SAME MIRRORED POSE in every view: each upper arm hangs straight down beside the ribs with a small gap of air, each elbow bent at 90 degrees, both forearms held HORIZONTAL at navel height and pointing STRAIGHT FORWARD, parallel to each other, the two fists in front of the belly about one hand-span forward of the belly and about shoulder-width apart; each hand an EMPTY fist with the thumb on top and the knuckles facing outward, as if each fist grips a vertical handle, nothing in the hands. Front view: both forearms point at the viewer, the two fists seen end-on in front of the belt. Back view: both elbows bent the same way, the forearms hidden in front of the body, no hanging hands. Both side views: one bent arm in profile, forearm horizontal pointing toward the face side, fist clearly in front of the belly with a visible gap. The camel head and long curved neck face straight ahead with the bronze nose ring; the two stone tablets strapped upright over the two humps on its back with red ropes, the gap between the humps showing the carved inscription glowing white-gold (painted as an opaque bright engraving, no halo); same fur, bells, rope necklace, Dunhuang saddle-blanket skirt and cloth-wrapped shins as the design
design.turnaround_digits: each big hand a clenched fist with four curled thick fingers and a separate thumb on top, countable; each foot a big two-toed camel foot with two split hoof toes wrapped in cloth, both toes visible; the tablets, ears and skirt fully inside the frame.
design.turnaround_pose_v1: standing upright in a relaxed A-pose, arms hanging a little away from the body, BOTH HANDS EMPTY and open (NO stele shield, no weapon: the shield is a separate model), feet shoulder-width apart; the camel head facing straight ahead with the bronze nose ring; the two stone tablets strapped upright over the two humps on its back with red ropes, the gap between the humps showing the carved inscription glowing white-gold (painted as an opaque bright engraving, no halo); same fur, bells, rope necklace, Dunhuang saddle-blanket skirt and cloth-wrapped shins as the design
